
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/fangsmile/p/19105553" title="发布于 2025-09-22 16:43">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">VTable-Sheet：重新定义Web电子表格的开源解决方案</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div data-page-id="XBXndSsVnoihsqx7s6vcpjpAnMd" data-lark-html-role="root" data-docx-has-block-data="true">
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-Gbe9dC1MhoXAErxQAjfc4yU9nNj"><strong>导读</strong></h2>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-HZJ4dJJqyoLTPqxC0ATcPLqjnnc">VTable-Sheet是一个轻量级、高性能的电子表格组件，专为现代Web应用设计。它采用Canvas渲染技术，支持海量数据的流畅展示和编辑，为开发者提供了一个功能完备、易于集成的电子表格解决方案。</div>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-YTHEdqfndo8xRaxwK3Dcdagbnxb" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;10328eb6-1775-4f66-b618-72176dd178dd&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:522,&quot;width&quot;:735,&quot;currHeight&quot;:522,&quot;currWidth&quot;:735,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:522,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:735,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:1,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FMqLlb8Gy6oLCsqxXjw6cTh8pnVc%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;MqLlb8Gy6oLCsqxXjw6cTh8pnVc&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/png&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:39451,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://nabdzkuplp9.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=MjdiNzgzZmU5NTNhMDdkMDg5MGFkYWFjZTQ0MzlmZmZfOWQwSlQ3dnNDQWtNS3AwY3ZhdUhkT0RpNTNHR3BLeVRfVG9rZW46TXFMbGI4R3k2b0xDc3F4WGp3NmNUaDhwblZjXzE3NTg1MzAzMzM6MTc1ODUzMzkzM19WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/MqLlb8Gy6oLCsqxXjw6cTh8pnVc/?mount_node_token=YTHEdqfndo8xRaxwK3Dcdagbnxb&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="735" data-height="522" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://MqLlb8Gy6oLCsqxXjw6cTh8pnVc" data-lark-image-width="735" data-lark-image-height="522"></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-RShbdxAc5oO5gvx4rB8cMeEtnre"><strong>·</strong><strong>核心能力</strong></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-LPB9dFjh2oOUzExNWEpclWlonHe">1. <strong>高效性能</strong>：基于Canvas渲染技术，支持百万级数据的秒级渲染，确保流畅的用户体验。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-P8ZKdnH3VoJPiOxM2zYcPyernNY">2. <strong>完整功能</strong>：提供Excel级别的公式计算、数据筛选、单元格编辑等核心功能，满足企业级需求。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-AKhGdqrYAoDAthxA2UXcMFbEngc">3. <strong>灵活扩展</strong>：插件化架构设计，支持自定义功能扩展，轻松适配各种业务场景。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-NvFxd5mCco94UjxsPT1cZrAvnXp">4. <strong>易于集成</strong>：简单的API设计，几行代码即可快速集成到项目中，降低开发成本。</div>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-NgfJdBhaSojKOvxhdXKcDVbMnrh"><strong>快速上手</strong></h2>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-Hn5ZdzubIoB89rxBijncVzAHndk"><strong>获取 NPM 包</strong></h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-BHcQdVNtQocMn4xnnlfc6pkynvd">首先，你需要在项目根目录下使用以下命令安装：</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-TeHDdyziromUcJxNvrucf13jn3g"><code class="language-Bash" data-lark-language="Bash" data-wrap="false"># 使用npm安装
npm install @visactor/vtable-sheet

# 使用yarn安装
yarn add @visactor/vtable-sheet</code></pre>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-O4GtdSwlMoHbXgxaPQlcIdLlnBh"><strong>引入 VTable-Sheet</strong></h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-HfzVdqQ85ogtjox7MdDcBmOBn9o">通过 NPM 包引入</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-RC8cdK4kVoLiaXxb8BlcDvZwnse">在 JavaScript 文件顶部使用 import 引入 vtable-sheet：</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-RkTXddUzgoZLOFxoJuKcZ2v7nQb"><code class="language-JavaScript" data-lark-language="JavaScript" data-wrap="false">import { VTableSheet } from '@visactor/vtable-sheet';

const sheetInstance = new VTableSheet(document.getElementById('container'), {
  showFormulaBar: true,  // 显示公式栏
  showSheetTab: true,    // 显示底部表格页切换栏
  sheets: [
    {
      sheetKey: 'sheet1',
      sheetTitle: '销售数据',
      columns: [
        { title: '产品', width: 120 },
        { title: '销量', width: 100 },
        { title: '金额', width: 100 }
      ],
      data: [
        ['笔记本电脑', 120, 599900],
        ['智能手机', 350, 139650],
        ['平板电脑', 85, 220315]
      ]
    }
  ]
});</code></pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Oxpwd8RqfouvjpxDtQ1cP8rJnZc">运行后效果：</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-SVhJdQLoQo4Gy1xcgC9cgZA5nUb">&nbsp;</div>

<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-Y9RHdWpk5og1Gyxtxwzccvy7nfh"><strong>VTable-Sheet 的主要能力</strong></h2>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-QEqVd0SDBotcDdxl6JZcEvSmnov"><strong>灵活的数据展示能力</strong></h3>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-CMmHdIa6PofxX4xeBaGcVYkDnjc"><strong>单元格合并</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-YrEzd1uzroMPshxWTLkcHTDMn6f">单元格合并是报表制作中的常用功能，VTable-Sheet提供了灵活的合并能力，支持任意区域的单元格合并和拆分。</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-DyrAda3d6odBMlxRD7CcimDknCh"><code class="language-SQL" data-lark-language="SQL" data-wrap="false">import { VTableSheet } from '@visactor/vtable-sheet';

const sheetInstance = new VTableSheet(document.getElementById(CONTAINER_ID), {
    sheets: [{
      sheetKey: 'merge-demo',
      sheetTitle: '季度销售报表',
      data: [
        ['2024年销售报表', '', '', ''],
        ['', '', '', ''],
        ['产品名称', 'Q1销售额', 'Q2销售额', 'Q3销售额'],
        ['笔记本电脑', 1200000, 1500000, 1800000],
        ['智能手机', 2500000, 2800000, 3200000],
        ['合计', 3700000, 4300000, 5000000]
      ],
      cellMerge: [
        {
          text: '2024年销售报表',  // 合并标题行
          range: {
            start: { col: 0, row: 0 },
            end: { col: 3, row: 1 }
          }
        },
        {
          text: '合计',  // 合并合计行的标题单元格
          range: {
            start: { col: 0, row: 5 },
            end: { col: 0, row: 5 }
          }
        }
      ]
    }]
  });</code></pre>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-NgufdTuaToTv3rxufyScOVJgnMf" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;4c9e0133-dd01-4098-9532-e913a4d32654&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:336,&quot;width&quot;:767,&quot;currHeight&quot;:336,&quot;currWidth&quot;:767,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:336,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:767,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:1,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FBTADbqwdeouwubxZOxmcQHLqnGC%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;BTADbqwdeouwubxZOxmcQHLqnGC&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/png&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:44183,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://nabdzkuplp9.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=NDJjNzM5ZjgwYmI4YzgyYmZjMzkwMTQyMTg2NThmOTlfbXNIMGJaUjFHVmQ5aXlSaEI2eldtYVhXRG9KbEtmTnJfVG9rZW46QlRBRGJxd2Rlb3V3dWJ4Wk94bWNRSExxbkdDXzE3NTg1MzAzMzM6MTc1ODUzMzkzM19WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/BTADbqwdeouwubxZOxmcQHLqnGC/?mount_node_token=NgufdTuaToTv3rxufyScOVJgnMf&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="767" data-height="336" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://BTADbqwdeouwubxZOxmcQHLqnGC" data-lark-image-width="767" data-lark-image-height="336"></div>

<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-SuXRdOl6Ro2NnDx2aULcWyHZnFf"><strong>冻结行列功能</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-SbQ5d2WIDoFTWvx6RbHcw73an6e">在处理大型数据集时，冻结行列功能可以让表头和关键列保持可见，方便数据查看和对比。</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-PHvQd5Hw9oHzWkxT2zkcVjANnxg"><code class="language-YAML" data-lark-language="YAML" data-wrap="false">import { VTableSheet } from '@visactor/vtable-sheet';

const sheetInstance = new VTableSheet(document.getElementById('container'), {
  sheets: [{
    sheetKey: 'frozen-demo',
    sheetTitle: '冻结示例',
    columns: [
      { title: '序号', field: 'id', width: 60 },
      { title: '产品', field: 'product', width: 100 },
      { title: '1月', field: 'jan', width: 80 },
      { title: '2月', field: 'feb', width: 80 },
      { title: '3月', field: 'mar', width: 80 }
    ],
    data: [
      [1, '笔记本', 1200, 1500, 1800],
      [2, '手机', 2500, 2800, 3000],
      [3, '平板', 900, 950, 1100],
      // ... 更多数据行
    ],
    frozenRowCount: 2,  // 冻结前两行
  }]
});</code></pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-U8vfdUwJco0X9Sx610PcvMAenQX">&nbsp;</div>

<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Vh53dXSLRotmYWxAssBcUpM3nRe">&nbsp;</div>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-QVuOdbXkCof5hzxa00pcGc1anVb"><strong>列宽行高调整</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-VezKdHphcojLMgxv4Jkct6xRnUd">灵活的列宽行高调整功能让用户能够根据内容自由调整表格布局，支持拖拽调整和双击自适应。</div>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-GAQxduJkNoZAkkx09cCc2XzTnIg" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;e2d64d12-b65e-4444-b1e6-3d7fdbf85a96&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:378,&quot;width&quot;:770,&quot;currHeight&quot;:378,&quot;currWidth&quot;:770,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:378,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:770,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:1,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FKE5bb2Q3WolcayxZ0nxctp2JnAc%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;KE5bb2Q3WolcayxZ0nxctp2JnAc&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/gif&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:170269,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://nabdzkuplp9.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=ZjU0OTMyMTIwNzdhZjYyMmQ2OTBkOTMzOTEwMTc4ODhfSGpybnhUdzJzbFFlckl1Rm5VUkd1WTBKblhuZ0xmRVVfVG9rZW46S0U1YmIyUTNXb2xjYXl4WjBueGN0cDJKbkFjXzE3NTg1MzAzMzM6MTc1ODUzMzkzM19WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/KE5bb2Q3WolcayxZ0nxctp2JnAc/?mount_node_token=GAQxduJkNoZAkkx09cCc2XzTnIg&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="770" data-height="378" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://KE5bb2Q3WolcayxZ0nxctp2JnAc" data-lark-image-width="770" data-lark-image-height="378"></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-KCVQdL4CPomreBxdLaKc5ontnpe">&nbsp;</div>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-RDJNd8Q2Io9Jj9xjnzEci6I6nag"><strong>高亮提示</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-NPYydh9oco0VqsxPytqcaYANnhc">选中单元格时会自动高亮对应的行列标题，帮助用户快速定位数据位置。</div>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-VwQcdUgMgoaTaQxnzrkcsOEnn3l" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;097aa5eb-8473-4fb5-b64a-c97c340d46d8&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:279,&quot;width&quot;:759,&quot;currHeight&quot;:279,&quot;currWidth&quot;:759,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:279,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:759,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:1,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FN2zkb1ZymorlBMxEk8UcUueFnWc%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;N2zkb1ZymorlBMxEk8UcUueFnWc&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/png&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:37467,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://nabdzkuplp9.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=MjM2Nzk3NDc5ZGMxNDE1ODQwMDk5MWFiNjkwZDcyZGVfTk01TlJUZTVWTEM1b01jOTdjd2NuTzVTMVdnQkJwallfVG9rZW46TjJ6a2IxWnltb3JsQk14RWs4VWNVdWVGbldjXzE3NTg1MzAzMzM6MTc1ODUzMzkzM19WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/N2zkb1ZymorlBMxEk8UcUueFnWc/?mount_node_token=VwQcdUgMgoaTaQxnzrkcsOEnn3l&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="759" data-height="279" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://N2zkb1ZymorlBMxEk8UcUueFnWc" data-lark-image-width="759" data-lark-image-height="279"></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-EuHBdsr7oooPSExmNIJcdpRgnAc">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-NOIRdKBlWoOdGfxyYUScnLp0npg"><strong>便利的数据编辑功能</strong></h3>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-NGfxdeldXoZeAGx9gLQcAzlZnYg"><strong>单元格编辑</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Mc4TdFOznoqFhYxC6UMcgeQqnMh">简单直观的编辑体验是电子表格的核心。双击单元格即可进入编辑模式，支持多种数据类型的输入和验证。</div>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-QLWEdCBOlorVu1xrlsXcSKCJnZd" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;4a535797-36e0-44f5-92ec-f11f6b5f5be1&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:396,&quot;width&quot;:953,&quot;currHeight&quot;:396,&quot;currWidth&quot;:953,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:396,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:953,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:1,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FLVzgbMf0QoWOicxQ5g2cc77AnEd%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;LVzgbMf0QoWOicxQ5g2cc77AnEd&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/png&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:113699,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://nabdzkuplp9.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=MDBmMWUzZmQ2Zjg4MWIzYjNhOWRmNTFlMmVjM2FiZDhfbU9wcEoxWUxrV3ZGNnZkRjNCQWRXS0xQZmd3UTd5OXhfVG9rZW46TFZ6Z2JNZjBRb1dPaWN4UTVnMmNjNzdBbkVkXzE3NTg1MzAzMzM6MTc1ODUzMzkzM19WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/LVzgbMf0QoWOicxQ5g2cc77AnEd/?mount_node_token=QLWEdCBOlorVu1xrlsXcSKCJnZd&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="953" data-height="396" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://LVzgbMf0QoWOicxQ5g2cc77AnEd" data-lark-image-width="953" data-lark-image-height="396"></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Gn59d9LcdoUzOdxKL3hcGifHnhd">&nbsp;</div>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-CzBBdlts9oDyQhxCVwAcWO2Gnyg"><strong>行列操作</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-XLVxdV06LofjW5xqXEhcPyQInVh">VTable-Sheet通过AddRowColumnPlugin插件提供了直观的行列操作功能：</div>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-IOjHdBY9WorFWGxYTYncCmvenwd" data-list="bullet"><strong>可视化操作</strong>：鼠标悬停时显示添加按钮，点击即可新增行列</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-AYcUdkzgKoLcR6xMMx2cLRIZnpd" data-list="bullet"><strong>灵活的插入位置</strong>：可在任意位置插入新的行或列</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-KLCxdq3ezo1VhOxDPhOcG8ZEnze" data-list="bullet"><strong>自定义回调</strong>：支持自定义新增行列的数据内容和格式</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-UqF4dm2utoVwkSxBusjcqGWvnzW" data-list="bullet"><strong>右键菜单集成</strong>：结合ContextMenuPlugin，提供完整的插入、删除、隐藏等操作</li>
</ul>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-A8CwdM1W9o6ItZxSuNWcnQh3neg">&nbsp;</div>

<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-LD7FdVpT9oaa6zxyD74cYaxEnMc">操作简单直观，无需记忆复杂的快捷键，鼠标悬停即可看到操作提示。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-OCpDdyKIVoYX7SxYmiJc85YTnbh">&nbsp;</div>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-F75jdFvsSoVgLaxeSt9clyq7nne"><strong>填充柄功能</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Mg2idIrQCo5cc0xTCQbc62qNn0g">VTable-Sheet 提供类似Excel的填充柄功能：</div>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-WbTkdYPgholaiUxqSE1c49c3nIf" data-list="bullet"><strong>智能识别数据模式</strong>：自动识别数字序列、日期序列、文本模式等</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-WNPGdMAuSoFZWWxh91xcT9RlnGc" data-list="bullet"><strong>多种填充模式</strong>：支持复制填充和序列填充两种模式</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Ll8SdByrmo5OkjxHdgycYgFSnVb" data-list="bullet"><strong>灵活的操作方式</strong>：拖拽填充或双击快速填充</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-FcGxdMU95oUIBaxHL8PcfXtmnLc" data-list="bullet"><strong>丰富的内置规则</strong>：支持日期序列、中文数字、星期序列等多种模式</li>
</ul>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-Q9r9d1ftSoL4WrxmoVIcL30fnad" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;308b62f5-437e-4174-a497-960df7d3857a&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:374,&quot;width&quot;:834,&quot;currHeight&quot;:374,&quot;currWidth&quot;:834,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:374,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:834,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:1,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FEPZBbxZWZowVOaxItGJc45Zhnsd%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;EPZBbxZWZowVOaxItGJc45Zhnsd&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/gif&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:181641,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://nabdzkuplp9.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=ZWRiMzM2MDljNDAzYmE3ZmQwNzY1NWRiYTRlNWI1MjhfUUo3WklJS2xPR3RJajRNN05xeUx1a3B4VVVhNVcySnNfVG9rZW46RVBaQmJ4Wldab3dWT2F4SXRHSmM0NVpobnNkXzE3NTg1MzAzMzM6MTc1ODUzMzkzM19WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/EPZBbxZWZowVOaxItGJc45Zhnsd/?mount_node_token=Q9r9d1ftSoL4WrxmoVIcL30fnad&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="834" data-height="374" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://EPZBbxZWZowVOaxItGJc45Zhnsd" data-lark-image-width="834" data-lark-image-height="374"></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-SuiDdBuaJolzGsxbklEcilDoncg">使用方式简单直观：选中单元格后，拖拽右下角的填充柄即可快速填充数据。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-TuVsdupP0oU6SmxAPLhcX6Q8nQf">&nbsp;</div>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-TabtdZK8Fo3GLDxST0Kc1Drun25"><strong>快捷键支持</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-L1TSdyoJVodpQ2xrvwecjV8RnNb">VTable-Sheet支持常用的键盘操作：</div>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-OiJsdlSqJoFR8CxxOFjcwJRCnNJ" data-list="bullet"><strong>编辑快捷键</strong>：Enter确认编辑、Tab切换单元格、方向键导航</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-KYSldSMZvoTdntxGmv2cmhbunhf" data-list="bullet"><strong>复制粘贴</strong>：Ctrl+C/V/X复制粘贴剪切、Ctrl+A全选</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-IakHdEEp4oMyQixzWJac9O0Hnhd" data-list="bullet"><strong>区域选择</strong>：Shift+鼠标连续选择、Ctrl+鼠标多选</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Ef9zdLcLbocdECxUTQZcengrnuh" data-list="bullet"><strong>智能编辑</strong>：双击进入编辑、F2编辑当前单元格</li>
</ul>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-W5O0dXqcHoSsulxGc1fcFApynjf">让Excel用户无需学习成本，即可流畅使用VTable-Sheet。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-TgXDdrTFmoDhtzxZtNTcv3ItnEd">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-KRy5dhUB6oC8b9xZGzKcNLP0nPe"><strong>强大的数据分析功能</strong></h3>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-LStLdTQg7oXfVBxiOspc3sDrnec"><strong>公式计算</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-PlF1dByqjov5LrxjfuFclM4jnif">VTable-Sheet集成了HyperFormula计算引擎，目前支持常用的函数：</div>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-PcROdMuy9oJNDFxo8nJc66Genec" data-list="bullet"><strong>数学函数</strong>：SUM、AVERAGE、MAX、MIN、ROUND等</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-ZeAgdn4zDownYFxrziichtdBnHh" data-list="bullet"><strong>逻辑函数</strong>：IF、AND、OR、NOT等</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-SRPQd6t8Uob6cjxOcsycjEohnLg" data-list="bullet"><strong>文本函数</strong>：CONCATENATE、LEFT、RIGHT、LEN等</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-KYSgdSM3ToVjU2xtgKGcbujEnPb" data-list="bullet"><strong>日期函数</strong>：TODAY、NOW、YEAR、MONTH、DAY等</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-XfxgdQD8WofntYxGtOccSBZon4f" data-list="bullet"><strong>查找函数</strong>：VLOOKUP、INDEX、MATCH等</li>
</ul>

<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-XXLVdr4imoWvCGxi8OlcHiwMn4c"><strong>公式编辑器</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-RgwBdWvTRomYBvxVJiwcFUzdnHg">公式编辑器不仅仅是一个输入框，它提供了智能提示、参数提示、语法高亮等功能，让公式编写变得轻松高效。</div>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-W2RIdHutQoSkOCxJN7qcuG5pnRb" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;5d8383a3-6c69-4942-9b6b-d2c3502c1933&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:354,&quot;width&quot;:760,&quot;currHeight&quot;:354,&quot;currWidth&quot;:760,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:354,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:760,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:1,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FPFdAbz2MDoYVG1xnu4Mc4bXKnib%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;PFdAbz2MDoYVG1xnu4Mc4bXKnib&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/gif&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:64152,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://nabdzkuplp9.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=ZTMzYWE4ZWU1OTEyNGE2OGJhMzcwMWIxN2JmOTk5MzdfeTF3c0l3ZXd1dWNuMDFubTNSZk01TUFKTmc0M3VnZEZfVG9rZW46UEZkQWJ6Mk1Eb1lWRzF4bnU0TWM0YlhLbmliXzE3NTg1MzAzMzM6MTc1ODUzMzkzM19WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/PFdAbz2MDoYVG1xnu4Mc4bXKnib/?mount_node_token=W2RIdHutQoSkOCxJN7qcuG5pnRb&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="760" data-height="354" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://PFdAbz2MDoYVG1xnu4Mc4bXKnib" data-lark-image-width="760" data-lark-image-height="354"></div>

<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-VN59dwiHGo2YOMxNFz5cXGNlnNe"><strong>数据筛选</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-FE5hdNlFToYZOyxVKRbcBlvInWe">支持按值筛选和按条件筛选两种模式：</div>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-UUHKdKByYo0KCJx952Nc1mTunTb" data-list="bullet"><strong>按值筛选</strong>：通过勾选列表快速筛选所需数据</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-MaKVdboPHoaqGXxYXdCcQDPWnCc" data-list="bullet"><strong>按条件筛选</strong>：支持大于、小于、包含、介于等复杂条件</li>
</ul>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-XqHOdtBuloMQjuxd67Kc0MHonxc"><code class="language-JavaScript" data-lark-language="JavaScript" data-wrap="false">import { VTableSheet } from '@visactor/vtable-sheet';

const sheetInstance = new VTableSheet(document.getElementById('container'), {
  sheets: [{
    sheetKey: 'filter-demo',
    sheetTitle: '筛选示例',
    filter: true,  // 启用筛选功能
    columns: [
      { title: '姓名', field: 'name', width: 100, filter: false },
      { title: '年龄', field: 'age', width: 80 },
      { title: '部门', field: 'dept', width: 100 },
      { title: '薪资', field: 'salary', width: 100 }
    ],
    data: [
      ['张三', 25, '技术部', 8000],
      ['李四', 30, '产品部', 12000],
      ['王五', 28, '技术部', 9500],
      ['赵六', 35, '市场部', 15000]
    ]
  }]
});</code></pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-G1cidfg9IoDg96xk3yScQlTTnef">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-Nf8Ed5bTRo6OlIx9kuvcreoqnsd" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;410f9a6c-6a00-45c2-98c9-1e55be722c49&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:556,&quot;width&quot;:1108,&quot;currHeight&quot;:556,&quot;currWidth&quot;:1108,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:556,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:1108,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:1,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FG17tbPUPWoMyMbxan8WcJTzunRd%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;G17tbPUPWoMyMbxan8WcJTzunRd&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/gif&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:175396,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://nabdzkuplp9.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=OWYxMzM2OWQ3Y2RmZWNmMDRkNDU3ODdhNTExMzU1N2FfdUF2d0tna0Y0WkRsMTlIRVdOZWxBamRhZzlKdXlweURfVG9rZW46RzE3dGJQVVBXb015TWJ4YW44V2NKVHp1blJkXzE3NTg1MzAzMzM6MTc1ODUzMzkzM19WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/G17tbPUPWoMyMbxan8WcJTzunRd/?mount_node_token=Nf8Ed5bTRo6OlIx9kuvcreoqnsd&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="1108" data-height="556" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://G17tbPUPWoMyMbxan8WcJTzunRd" data-lark-image-width="1108" data-lark-image-height="556"></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-CbmRdvZIFoZrHNxIFYxctk51ncd">筛选状态可以保存和恢复，支持多列组合筛选。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-BZBhdGKVKo570GxVU8nccyApnFg">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-PivXdLDG6oBKTBxp1Hpc6HpWnDf"><strong>完善的数据组织与管理</strong></h3>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-M9RPdZQpTooxiuxLIbvckpGSnCf"><strong>多表格页管理</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-L4bsd6znqoQGjcx96fZcs66jnTb">VTable-Sheet支持在一个实例中管理多个表格页，类似Excel的工作簿概念：</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-DDPmdZKzVoLDDLxv3eEcU4rjnPA"><code class="language-JavaScript" data-lark-language="JavaScript" data-wrap="false">import { VTableSheet } from '@visactor/vtable-sheet';

const sheetInstance = new VTableSheet(document.getElementById('container'), {
  showSheetTab: true,  // 显示底部表格页切换栏
  sheets: [
    {
      sheetKey: 'sales',
      sheetTitle: '销售数据',
      columns: [
        { title: '产品', field: 'product', width: 100 },
        { title: '销量', field: 'sales', width: 80 },
        { title: '金额', field: 'amount', width: 100 }
      ],
      data: [
        ['笔记本', 120, 599900],
        ['手机', 350, 139650]
      ],
      active: true  // 设为活动表格页
    },
    {
      sheetKey: 'inventory',
      sheetTitle: '库存数据',
      columns: [
        { title: '产品', field: 'product', width: 100 },
        { title: '库存', field: 'stock', width: 80 }
      ],
      data: [
        ['笔记本', 50],
        ['手机', 120]
      ]
    }
  ]
});</code></pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-VagWd1TkyouicjxKmUjcaea9nAf">支持动态添加、删除、切换表格页，每个表格页可以独立配置样式和功能。</div>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-UC2EdDMJpon9q6xSiAJcwRvCn3o" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;fe98b489-d28b-4c94-b134-dbafb1ee5351&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:648,&quot;width&quot;:998,&quot;currHeight&quot;:648,&quot;currWidth&quot;:998,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:648,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:998,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:1,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FWodSbZ7ksolJu4xbpqscT4Dvnlb%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;WodSbZ7ksolJu4xbpqscT4Dvnlb&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/gif&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:158722,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://nabdzkuplp9.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=NjI0MWI4ZDNmNjhlODFlNTcyY2ZmNTQ4OWM5YTQyZGNfRTVBTmVOYVBpM0Z3Z3B5NUp3ZG1aNVhRTFZJbmV6VGdfVG9rZW46V29kU2JaN2tzb2xKdTR4YnBxc2NUNER2bmxiXzE3NTg1MzAzMzM6MTc1ODUzMzkzM19WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/WodSbZ7ksolJu4xbpqscT4Dvnlb/?mount_node_token=UC2EdDMJpon9q6xSiAJcwRvCn3o&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="998" data-height="648" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://WodSbZ7ksolJu4xbpqscT4Dvnlb" data-lark-image-width="998" data-lark-image-height="648"></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-UWqMdMuqFov9VcxqstBcriRonwg">&nbsp;</div>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-UkO5dX15doMiOIx3HtBcT2gfnZg"><strong>数据持久化</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Vu9ad8mTZoTscdx4k7Hcbe6qnRg">提供完整的状态保存和恢复机制：</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GObKdZJ7NorCwsxFdCUcr4AtnGd"><code class="language-JavaScript" data-lark-language="JavaScript" data-wrap="false">// 保存当前状态
const config = sheetInstance.saveToConfig();
localStorage.setItem('sheet-state', JSON.stringify(config));

// 恢复状态
const savedConfig = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sheet-state'));
const newInstance = new VTableSheet(document.getElementById('container'), savedConfig);</code></pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-FfWPd6R7borGBKxZyGgcXPyTnSb">可保存的状态包括：数据内容、筛选条件、活动表格页、公式设置、合并单元格等。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-SEd3dvVIOojIbHxXrSKcUgTVncd">&nbsp;</div>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-WCaldpxa6opZBExCYvQcjoT0nKe"><strong>导入导出功能</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-NJEMddCheoDMvrxCzvIcGRo6nGc">支持CSV、XLSX格式的导入导出，方便与Excel等工具交换数据：</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-El5xdpvbEoaY5AxAj2Ac5kz2nLb"><code class="language-JavaScript" data-lark-language="JavaScript" data-wrap="false">// 导出为Excel
sheetInstance.exportSheetToFile('xlsx');

// 导入Excel文件
sheetInstance.importFileToSheet();</code></pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-I2thdFfLXoWfVyxnkfZcl3dBnzb">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-P2lqd8U04oYteUxAJcGcvy3WnEg"><strong>高级的自定义功能</strong></h3>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-VzCAdUYH0oSJ5ZxquykcNjNqnye"><strong>主题定制</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-WQTWdXChMoTRagxUUGxcFFrEnjf">VTable-Sheet提供了主题定制功能，可以自定义表格的视觉样式：</div>
<pre class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-NQa0d0OwnoQaxIxENPvckVvynCb"><code class="language-JavaScript" data-lark-language="JavaScript" data-wrap="false">import { VTableSheet } from '@visactor/vtable-sheet';

const sheetInstance = new VTableSheet(document.getElementById('container'), {
  sheets: [{
    sheetKey: 'theme-demo',
    sheetTitle: '主题示例',
    columns: [
      { title: '姓名', field: 'name', width: 100 },
      { title: '部门', field: 'dept', width: 100 },
      { title: '职位', field: 'position', width: 120 }
    ],
    data: [
      ['张三', '技术部', '工程师'],
      ['李四', '产品部', '经理']
    ]
  }],
  theme: {
    // 行列序号样式
    rowSeriesNumberCellStyle: {
      bgColor: '#f0f0f0',
      color: '#666666'
    },
    // 表格主题
    tableTheme: {
      headerStyle: {
        bgColor: '#e6f7ff',
        color: '#0066cc',
        fontWeight: 'bold'
      },
      bodyStyle: {
        fontSize: 14,
        color: '#333333'
      },
      // 选中样式
      selectionStyle: {
        cellBorderColor: '#1890ff'
      }
    }
  }
});</code></pre>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-OxVcdg0oooLoBPxXPTzcuW3Gn0c">内置多套精美主题（ARCO、BRIGHT、DARK等），也支持扩展自定义主题。</div>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-TPpndyemGoVqu5xJislcudAOnQh" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;4a54f325-c175-4719-80ae-35d0162bb85e&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:327,&quot;width&quot;:747,&quot;currHeight&quot;:327,&quot;currWidth&quot;:747,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:327,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:747,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:1,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FFu1sbHGRropWVmxBcBDcwSZVnLR%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;Fu1sbHGRropWVmxBcBDcwSZVnLR&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/png&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:28881,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://nabdzkuplp9.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=ZDBkOTU4NDM1YzNhMmJkMzRiMzgwODJiMmQyZTM5ZDlfR1F3Wm4xdlpyblZYSk8wZ1FNQTFGbHVoZ2tiTVY4aHBfVG9rZW46RnUxc2JIR1Jyb3BXVm14QmNCRGN3U1pWbkxSXzE3NTg1MzAzMzM6MTc1ODUzMzkzM19WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/Fu1sbHGRropWVmxBcBDcwSZVnLR/?mount_node_token=TPpndyemGoVqu5xJislcudAOnQh&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="747" data-height="327" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://Fu1sbHGRropWVmxBcBDcwSZVnLR" data-lark-image-width="747" data-lark-image-height="327"></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-CU0Ddbq1ho0SW0x4wxScHy6nntf">&nbsp;</div>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-GdX3dfgCzomvKzxhQAvcaWBfnIb"><strong>右键菜单</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-UExydheKyohvgCx90mvcMug8nOg">VTable-Sheet提供了完整的右键菜单功能，支持不同区域的自定义菜单：</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-KLS4dA2HCohpq6xxHNYcPm8vnge">右键菜单支持：</div>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-PDsnd9QSDonM1xxRIAzc3FoOngc" data-list="bullet"><strong>分区域配置</strong>：表头、表体、行列序号区域可配置不同菜单</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Idy7dMmhOo1nY1xddmNcpsBfnxh" data-list="bullet"><strong>内置功能</strong>：复制、剪切、粘贴、插入、删除、冻结、合并等</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-MBTnd3hBTodgP5x9UTqczncLn4g" data-list="bullet"><strong>自定义扩展</strong>：支持添加自定义菜单项和处理逻辑</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GSHzdcVMNoO3gGxFw6YcfIr3nHc" data-list="bullet"><strong>动态调整</strong>：根据上下文动态显示/隐藏菜单项</li>
</ul>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-FpePdrkIQoqqO4xsgdacuvtAnod">&nbsp;</div>
<h4 class="heading-4 ace-line old-record-id-SqHzdGgFdoQ8Elxs2TKc6zfhnCf"><strong>插件化架构</strong></h4>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GyFOdwqhvoNUzjxbPxXclJ1cnpe">VTable-Sheet采用插件化架构，许多功能通过插件实现。这种设计保持了核心的简洁，同时为社区贡献者提供了扩展的空间。欢迎更多开发者贡献插件，共同丰富VTable-Sheet的功能。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-YUrpdhp8iodm4UxXkCxcZ0EgnMc">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-DIv0dt5jToNtG8xVnaZcMjWMnTp">具体来说，VTable-Sheet 采用分层架构，将核心引擎、插件功能和上层应用解耦，从而带来灵活性和可扩展性。</div>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-ZAuUdR48OoddG9xCM8tcMEXQnBh" data-list="bullet"><strong>VTable (核心引擎)</strong>：作为整个系统的基石，VTable 是一个高性能的表格渲染与交互引擎。它提供了底层的表格组件 ListTable 和一套标准的插件接口。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-A6pFdDgCVoIARsxwkS1c90WEnSc" data-list="bullet"><strong>VTable-Plugins (功能套件)</strong>：这是一个独立的插件库，提供了如筛选、右键菜单、自动填充等一系列可复用的功能模块。这些插件遵循 VTable 的标准接口，可以灵活地被任何基于 VTable 的项目使用。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-M5tcdVPXBoNLzUxY2FrcIcF4nS5" data-list="bullet"><strong>VTable-Sheet (整合应用)</strong>：VTable-Sheet 是一个更高层次的封装，它基于 VTable 构建，并消费 VTable-Plugins 中的插件。它通过一个插件工厂 (table-plugins.ts)，根据用户的 Sheet 配置来动态加载和配置所需的插件，最终将一个功能完备的电子表格呈现给用户。</li>
</ul>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-O1MEd2prtoHy8txAZozcaDPUnDb" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;d552dd60-4910-466d-b33d-b1f56bb1c508&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:720,&quot;width&quot;:1280,&quot;currHeight&quot;:720,&quot;currWidth&quot;:1280,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:720,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:1280,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:1,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FU0rfbUGhooVVg8xX6OPcXLFonAg%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;U0rfbUGhooVVg8xX6OPcXLFonAg&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/png&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:65492,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://nabdzkuplp9.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=ZDU0MDBiNjE2MWU4ZDY2ZmY0ZTFhNmY0ODRkZmFjMjVfaGZCeWlrczVVcVJWYzdNWmJVSWg0VTJ2UGl1Q1lGbXpfVG9rZW46VTByZmJVR2hvb1ZWZzh4WDZPUGNYTEZvbkFnXzE3NTg1MzAzMzM6MTc1ODUzMzkzM19WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/U0rfbUGhooVVg8xX6OPcXLFonAg/?mount_node_token=O1MEd2prtoHy8txAZozcaDPUnDb&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="1280" data-height="720" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://U0rfbUGhooVVg8xX6OPcXLFonAg" data-lark-image-width="1280" data-lark-image-height="720"></div>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-DYkodwmyBovBFlxrjbwcsL2YnxV"><strong>小结</strong></h2>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-ECrZdVdKwoLictxh1Z4cPPLpnCe">VTable-Sheet是一个正在成长的开源电子表格组件，我们致力于为Web应用提供良好的电子表格解决方案。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-S9Xad499xoxfgnxJJ9lcCHngn8f">它将桌面端Excel的强大功能带到了Web端，同时充分发挥了Web技术的优势。无论您是要构建在线办公系统、数据分析平台、财务报表系统，还是任何需要电子表格功能的Web应用，VTable-Sheet都能可以胜任。</div>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-ZdwRdlv4XoZaVRx6qoHchfRzn1f"><strong>欢迎交流</strong></h2>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-MkGPdHF2loCsZkxf4Qwc281jn6f"><strong>官方资源</strong></h3>

<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-SUabdMuA2otAiyxkUbjcCS0Jn3I">- <strong>官方文档</strong>：https://visactor.io/vtable</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GzEgdYL7HoEuNHxSodqcKB6EnKd">- <strong>在线演示</strong>：https://visactor.io/vtable/demo</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-M9wjd0hcko3OLNxY3yec1ZpSnnd">&nbsp;</div>
